get.description: OpenScreeps static landing page for game clients.

post.description: OpenScreeps-only operator command dispatch. Unknown fields are rejected; each mutation is serialized and durably committed. The request action discriminates the command shapes below. Several actions delete or replace world/player data, change resources or publish to players. Do not invoke them without explicit operator authorization. Domain validation failures use HTTP 400 here, not the gameplay HTTP-200 error envelope.

403.description: Admin API disabled, wrong secret, or protected system user.

404.description: Requested player, room or bot not found.

get.description: OpenScreeps-only administrative endpoint. Requires the separately configured administrator bearer secret, never a player token. Disabled with 403 when no sufficiently long secret is configured.

403.description: Admin API disabled, wrong secret, or protected system user.

404.description: Requested player, room or bot not found.

get.summary: Read standalone client or terrain asset
get.description: OpenScreeps wildcard asset route. map/W1N1.png renders room terrain at 150×150; map/zoom2/W0N0.png renders an aligned 4×4-room sector at 200×200. Other files come from the optional operator asset directory, with traversal and symlink containment checks. The path can contain slashes; some generated clients encode them, so preserve the wildcard path when using this endpoint.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Relative wildcard asset path, potentially containing slash-delimited segments.

200.description: Asset bytes; content type follows the file extension.

get.description: OpenScreeps health probe. Returns the committed game time and pause state. An unhealthy kernel or failed read returns 503.

200.description: Successful result or logical API failure. Inspect error even on HTTP 200.

AdminToken.description: OpenScreeps administrator secret (at least 32 characters), distinct from all player tokens. Disabled unless SCREEPS_ADMIN_TOKEN is configured.

Bearer.description: OpenScreeps player-session alternative to X-Token (same session token). Successful authenticated responses rotate the token in the X-Token response header.

oneOf.description: Read the same world/operator status returned by GET /admin/status.
Pause automatic ticks.
Resume automatic ticks.
Advance 1–1000 real world ticks; returns completed tick count and game time.
Set milliseconds between automatic ticks.
Create a player. gcl is raw control progress, not a room-count level. Username/account constraints also apply.

resources.description: Only INTERSHARD_RESOURCES names accepted by the pinned engine. Zero removes an entry; others set the amount.

oneOf.description: Update one non-system player selected by exactly one of userId or username. At least one changed field required. Credits are rounded to thousandths; gcl and power are raw progress totals. Zero resource amounts delete those entries.
Destructive: remove player world state, credentials, sessions and server-private account records; revoke authentication. NPC/system accounts are protected.
Generate a room and terrain; reject invalid domain geometry/options.
Open a room now or at the given Unix-millisecond timestamp.
Close a room.
Destructive: remove a room from the world.

Create a two-way portal pair between rooms, like screeps.com's: eight portals around an indestructible wall in each room, each leading to the matching portal tile of the other room (which leads back). `options` applies to every portal of both rooms.
Create an NPC terminal in an existing room.
Add an inline-code bot in a room; returns its player identity.
Reload all players running the named bot AI from inline modules; 404 if no players use that AI.
Destructive: remove the named bot player and its private account records.
Spawn an NPC stronghold with optional explicit template, position, owner and deployment delay.
Expand a stronghold in the specified room.
List available stronghold template names and descriptions.
Run the named maintenance job immediately without updating its regular schedule.
Read queued notification batches, including private player message content.
Publish an operator message to connected game clients.
Export complete durable server state; contains sensitive player data and credential hashes.
Destructive: validate and replace the durable world from a complete versioned server snapshot. Never send untrusted or incomplete snapshots.

AdminCommandResult.description: Response shape is selected by action; all successful admin responses include ok: 1. server-message and snapshot-import return only ok.

AdminModules.description: Module source text or base64 WASM objects. main is required. The combined lengths of names and source/base64 strings may not exceed 5 MiB.

world.description: Serialized @openscreeps/game world. Snapshot import validates its complete versioned game-state contract; preserve all exported fields.

runtime.description: Serialized bot runtime, including code and player Memory. Contains sensitive player data.

apiTokens.description: Persistent API tokens keyed by the SHA-256 hash of the token; absent in snapshots written before API tokens existed.

AdminSnapshot.description: Versioned server snapshot with additional game collections retained verbatim. This is a round-trip/export-import payload, not a client-authored world editor schema. Contains credential hashes, messages and player Memory: never publish or log it.

AdminStrongholdOptions.description: templateName must name a template returned by stronghold-templates. An explicit position requires both coordinates and templateName.
